options.text: Ask about the Skillcape of Farming.

steps.text: If the player doesn't have 99 farming:

steps.player: What is that cape you're wearing?

steps.npc: This is a Skillcape of Farming, isn't it incredible? It's a symbol of my ability as the finest farmer in the land and wearing it increases my herb yield!

steps.player: Can I buy a Skillcape of Farming from you?

steps.npc: Of course, fellow farmer. If you wear this cape you'll receive increased yields from your herbs. That'll be 99000 coins.
No skin off my teeth, but if you change your mind, the price will still be the same.

options.text: Sure, not many people own one.

steps.player: Sure, not many people own one.

steps.text: If the player does not have at least 99,000 coins in their inventory:

steps.player: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.

steps.npc: Well, come back and see me when you do.

steps.text: If the player has at least 99,000 coins but not enough inventory space:

steps.npc: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.

steps.text: If the player has at least 99,000 coins and enough inventory space:

steps.npc: That's true; us Master Farmers are a unique breed.

steps.text: Player receives a Farming cape and Farming hood and pays 99,000 coins.

steps.player: May I have another hood for my cape, please?

steps.text: Martin hands you another hood for your skillcape.

steps.player: Okay, this time I've really solved your problems! I've woken up the Fairy Queen!

steps.npc: Hmm, right. You'll forgive me if I reserve judgement on this until I actually have some crops grow.

steps.player: Of course. The problem was the Godfather, he wanted to take control of Zanaris himself, so he didn't give Fairy Nuff the Queen's secateurs!

steps.npc: Godfather...Fairy Nuff...the Queen, I don't know what you're talking about and I don't care. I just want my crops to start growing again. Come back and claim your reward once they've had a chance to grow.

overhead-dialogue-failed-pickpocket-atte.npc: Cor blimey mate, what are ye doing in me pockets?

overhead-dialogue-failed-pickpocket-atte.text: Hits the player for 3 damage for each failed pickpocket

overhead-dialogue-talking-to-him-after-s.npc: You're the thief who stole from me!
